remarks: Welcome to 701 Willardshire Rd! Set on 1.7 acres overlooking Cazenovia Creek in the Orchard Park School District, this 3,000 sq ft hillside ranch offers scenic views and flexible living space. The main level features cherry wood floors, a great room with cathedral ceiling, skylights, gas fireplace and window seat with storage. A large dining room window frames the views, while the kitchen offers quartz counters, island, breakfast bar and pantry. Enjoy the spectacular scenery from the three-season room, where you may even catch a glimpse of bald eagles soaring above the creek! The primary suite has two large closets and a bath with double sinks and walk-in shower. A second bedroom has its own full bath. A den with French doors and pocket door to bedroom, foyer with sidelights, first-floor laundry and half bath complete this level. The finished lower-level living suite is ideal for multigenerational living, extended family,  guests or potential rental income. It offers two bedrooms, full bath, living room with gas fireplace, patio access, second kitchen with island plus workshop and storage. Brand new roof, gutters and skylights provide extra piece of mind. Outside enjoy a circular driveway, 2.5-car attached garage with pull-down stairs to overhead storage and hot/cold water, and a 12x24 barn-style outbuilding. An elevated deck at the rear of the property offers a peaceful retreat to relax and enjoy the natural surroundings. A truly special property offering space, flexibility and a scenic setting that's hard to find!  Also listed as B1721627
